lines: Jennifer Bailey explains how Apple Pay navigated the complex 'chicken and egg' network dynamics among banks, merchants, and payment networks to achieve massive scale.
The platform was deliberately architected to exclude Apple from storing sensitive transaction data, prioritizing user privacy as a core product feature.
Global adoption was significantly accelerated by leveraging existing contactless infrastructure and international regulatory mandates that required universal acceptance.
The Apple Wallet strategy now extends far beyond payments, aiming to systematically digitize and replace physical essentials like transit passes, car keys, and state IDs.
title: REPLAY: The Story of Apple Pay | Jennifer Bailey (2024)
